# Rust Tactical Companion Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server

apt install -y git curl ca-certificates

cd /mnt/server || exit 1

if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    echo "Directory is not empty, checking for existing git repo..."

        git pull origin ${BRANCH}

        git init
        git remote add origin ${GIT_ADDRESS}
        git fetch origin
        git checkout -f -t origin/${BRANCH}

else
    echo "Cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS} (branch: ${BRANCH})..."
    git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server/data

if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    /usr/local/bin/npm install --production
fi

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Rust Tactical Companion Installation Done"
